review_description: So far so good ! Kevin has been very good, right from the initial enquiry, we spoke for 40 minutes and me being an electrician I wanted to know everything ! He's been in the business longer than many and knows his business. The installers were fantastic, polite, quiet, got on with the job and installed my 10kW system in a day, it's very neat and tidy and they cleaned up very well on completion. It's early days but so far very happy. Definitely give Kevin a call if you're looking into a new system or upgrading.

Kevin from Track Energy gave very detailed advice and took the time to answer all my questions. Initially he gave consultation over the phone and then further advice during a site visit. I believe he put a system together that best meets our requirements and strikes the right balance between costs, performance and quality.Kevin took also care of all the paperwork and the communication with the power provider.The crew that did the installation was polite and friendly. The installation itself is very tidy.I definitely would recommend Track Energy.

Initial call requested a thorough understanding of my circumstances and wishes.  Seemed knowledgable and provided me with a more appropriate option that others didn't even bother to consider.  Installation was quick and efficient.  After installation follow up also very good.
I found Kevin from Track Energy Easy to understand and easy to work with. Kevin was not pushy he explained everything so I could understand. Thank you

Kevin at Track Energy was the only person who educated me about what I was 'getting in to'. He had lots of ideas about how to achieve what I wanted to do which be as "off grid" as possible in the suburbs and explained what the pros and cons were with each idea. We settled on a system that was not even hinted on by 6 other businesses. (Got the standard 6.3kW panels and 5 kW inverter  routine without ever asking what I wanted, they were all rushing to beat the battery rebate cut off date and sign up or you'll miss out type of pressure which puts many of us off I think)The installers were great, polite, tidy, informative and my wife felt comfortable with them by herself, B&B electrical. They turned up when they said they would and let us know what they were doing. Then hooked everything up to check it's running ok. Still waiting on the smart meter, the longest part of the whole process. But Kevin has provided great advice along the way, always available. Been a very positive experience, Kevin obviously loves this stuff and is right up to date with what's going on, his website shows that too. It's a solid investment that Kevin and B&B have made easy for us. Thanks so much, Craig and Melody

Very happy with our Track Energy system.High quality components, installed with no fuss and very quickly. Good communication with Kevin who was happy to modify the design to our specifications.Would definitely recommend our system to anyone that's interested.
Panels and inverter installed but not yet operational.  Lack of follow up with live connection.

Out of the 5 quotes that I got for Solar, Kevin from Track Energy spent the most time on the phone with me, he listened to what I wanted and worked within those parameters. Other companies tried to upsell me to larger systems or would not even talk to me about prices/brands until they had an on site consultation. They didn't require a deposit and offered a good time frame for installation.The installation itself looks flawless to me, no ugly hardware visible, very neat and tidy. The Huawei inverter is a very sleek and small design so it looks very neat a tidy on the wall, it also has good monitoring via an app on my phone.

After doing lots of research, I knew what I wanted (6.6kW of panels, not very worried about brand, and 5kW Fronius inverter). Kev was very knowledgeable and provided lots of advice about on panel brands. Very happy with the system so far.

Kevin Parker was helpful and made suggestions relating to the best value for money system. always answered any questions in time via Email or phone. I can highly recommend him to any looking to install Solar.
Kevin was very good, gave good customer service. The people that did the install were very good and the quality of the system and install is very good as far as I can judge.

Kevin was fantastic to deal with, he listened to what I wanted to achieve and presented a system that was better than I was originally expecting.  He provided me with a finance referral and I am now in a position where my loan payments are less than what I was paying fortnightly in electricity and I have a large enough system that I wont get power bills.  The system was installed quickly and the installers were prompt, professional and kept the area tidy.  I wouldn't hesitate in recommending Kevin and Track Energy.

Kevin from Track energy was extremely helpful and efficient. His quote was the cheapest on the system that I wanted. The installers were punctual, very friendly and polite and cleaned up before they left. Track Energy organised the grid connection on my behalf. Very impressed with the whole process. Would not hesitate to recommend Track Energy.

Kevin was great, he gave honest estimates of the impact of shading on system output, visited the site and took readings that supported his estimates, explained his reasoning behind all of the hardware he recommended and didnâ€™t try to sell me anything I didnâ€™t need. The installation team were professional and efficient and from what I can tell they did an excellent job.

Following a great referral from our parents, we gave Kevin a call to visit us and give us a quote. He was very courteous and knowledgeable. He explained all our options and was very prompt with emailing us his quote the next day. Upon our acceptance of the quote he arranged all necessary approvals and within a few short weeks contacted us to give us our installation date. The installers were just as prompt & professional and even came out the day before the installation date to get a head start with fitting the brackets. They were also courteous and professional & explained our installation options giving us the opportunity to have an input before commencement of the installation. We would highly recommend Track Energy to anyone looking at getting Solar.

Our decision was between two companies. They were both equal in their presentation and we felt both were trustworthy and their pricing was fairly close. The final decision had to be made for the solar panels with optimisers as we have shade for a lot of the day. We have not regretted spending a few hundred extra for the optimisers on the Longi panels. We are loving the Wifi and checking how much solar power we are producing and it helps plan your consumption for the day.
The tech's that installed the solar were great and very informative and it was installed when they originally said it would be . good work

Kevin was very good to deal with, as had to deal with a delayed new build.Installation was first class, but had to wait 6 weeks to get smart meter installed...AGL.Solar supplied power only to the house in this time, with zero export.As of 11 April, after the first day of export to the grid, and with a SA Power Networkslimit of export of 5kw, we had a total of 47.8kw generated, and 44.3kw exported, witha dappled cloudy day.Very pleased with the outcome. Bring on summer!

Kevin from track energyâ€™s quote was very professional in its layout to start with. His price was the cheapest of all 3 (not that really bothered me) and he explained the process. His initial quote and honesty when he came and quoted the job won me over. His techs that did the install were very good too,setting up my wifi and so I can monitor the system could not fault them. Extremely happy with my service all round and thanks to solar quotes I got the best experience with solar I could ask for, great work

Great pre-sales service, much bettet than the other 2 companies recommended. Price was unbeatable too. Very happy so far but still waiting for installation in the new year. Hopefully goes just as smoothly.
Great experience dealing with Kevin & his advise & knowledge. Smooth experience & prompt installation.

Installation was done over three visits, all went smoothly.  I already had a smart meter, but it needs to be reconfigured for solar. Still waiting on AGL to do this, apparently can take 10 business days.

Kev came across more as a fellow solar enthusiast than a salesman. He took the time to answer my technical questions with intelligent answers rather than the marketing material I had already read. He got on the roof and actually checked the space, optimised the design and recommended a better system than I had wanted / expected. The install is neat and tidy and hasn't caused any leaks or damage. Now going strong for 10 months and very happy with the whole process.Based on my experience I would recommend Track Energy for residential solar installs.

Very impressed with salesman/designer who was the only person to get on roof to actually see what he could fit. He was the only one to suggest optimization for a few panels that would get some shade in winter. This gave us confidence that he had properly considered our site and was working towards the optimum system.

Kevin was very helpful and informative with the technical questions I had about the quote. He organised everything with approvals and retailer meter change out.The installers were a great group who knew their work, worked efficiently (complete in about 3.5 hours) and were polite and willing to discuss any questions I had on the day.Happy to recommend Track Energy for residential solar system supply and install.
Very satisfied with the installation and performance so far.

I wasn't happy after installation it was like they didn't want to know you when it came to sending a receipt or connecting the Fronius to the Internet so we could monitor how much power we were making also they haven't updated it to date, otherwise  they were very good with cleaning up after themselves and they guy's installing were very friendly, just a shame I got left with a bad taste.
Since the system has not been installed yet (due in 1 week) it's a bit premature to comment on the end result, despite a good start.
Very happy with the whole process !
All good, and thanks for your website and assistance- it made the whole process much easier and faster.

Track energy supplied me with a system that other suppliers said couldnâ€™t be done. I wanted a battery ready system, and once the battery was installed that the solar would charge the battery even if the mains was out. Kevin made it work, and the quality of the installation was brilliant, as was the professionalism and conduct of the techs performing the install. Top notch.
